info.title: API.SH: PeoplePerHour
info.description: The PeoplePerHour API from API.SH: public PeoplePerHour data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

tags.name: Account
tags.description: Your balance, usage, logs and past responses. Free.

get.summary: Balance, plan, spend and spend limits
get.description: Credits by bucket (free monthly, plan, pay-as-you-go), the plan, credits spent today and this month (UTC), your spend limits and the key used. Free: costs no credits.

get.description: Calls, errors and credits per UTC day, and the top endpoints by credits. Free. Add output=csv for the daily rows as CSV.

401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

get.summary: Your calls of the last 30 days
get.description: Newest first. Filter by status, route prefix, key or time; page with `before` (the `next` value). Add output=csv|ndjson to download (up to 5,000 rows per request; the next cursor is in the x-next-cursor header). Free.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: ok, error, or an HTTP status like 502.

parameters.name: route
parameters.description: Route prefix, e.g. /tiktok/v1

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: Only calls made with this key id.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: ISO time.

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: Cursor from `next`.

401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

get.summary: Fetch a past response again, free
get.description: The exact response a call returned, for 30 days after the call, at no cost. Use the call's x-request-id. Supports output=csv|ndjson.

200.description: The stored response (headers: x-refetch: 1, x-original-time, x-original-route).

404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

get.description:
A PeoplePerHour freelancer by profile link (or `q`: the top search match): name, headline, location, languages, hourly rate and currency, rating, review count, projects worked on, buyers worked with, last active, response time, certification level, skills, industries, full about text, portfolio and offer counts and photo.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/peopleperhour-freelancer

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A peopleperhour.com freelancer link (/freelancer/<category>/<name>).

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search words: opens the top freelancer for them, instead of `url` (2 more credits than passing an id or link).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The reviews on a PeoplePerHour freelancer's profile, grouped by the job or offer they were left for (title, link, price): date, rating, text, the reviewer's country and the freelancer's reply, with the overall rating and review count. Reviewers are private clients, so their names and photos are not returned.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/peopleperhour-freelancer-reviews

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: The freelancer's peopleperhour.com/freelancer/<category>/<name> link.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

example.name: Integra Business Solutions TM

groups.title: Exclusive Logo From Award Winning UK Brand Specialists
Convert your logo image into vector

example.note: the profile shows the latest reviews of its latest jobs and offers; reviewers are private clients, only their country is returned

get.description:
Freelancers on PeoplePerHour for a skill or words, with the site's sort and filters: id, name, headline, link, photo, city and country, hourly rate (USD), rating and review count, projects completed, completion ratio, buyers worked with, endorsements, response time, certification level and skills, with the total and filter counts. 24 per page: pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 2 credits per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/peopleperhour-freelancers

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Skill or words, e.g. `wordpress` or `logo design`. Give this or `skill`.

parameters.name: skill
parameters.description: A skill name as the site lists it, e.g. `react js`, instead of `q`.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: relevance (default), latest, rate, rating, sales or cert.

parameters.name: cert
parameters.description: Certification level and higher: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 or top.

parameters.name: hourly_rate
parameters.description: Hourly rate band (USD): under_15, 15_35, 35_60 or over_60.

parameters.name: rating
parameters.description: Stars and up: 1, 2, 3 or 4.

parameters.name: min_projects
parameters.description: Projects completed at least: 5 or 50.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number. Pass `next_page` from the previous response; `next_page` is null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One freelance project on PeoplePerHour: title, budget, currency and USD estimate, pricing, proposals count, days left, experience level, skills, applicant location, dates and the full description. Give `url`, or `category`/`skill` (plus any list filter) to open the newest matching project.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/peopleperhour-job

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Project URL on peopleperhour.com.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Category slug, optionally with a subcategory: technology-programming, design, writing-translation, digital-marketing, business, video-photo-image, marketing-branding-sales, social-media, music-audio, artificial-intelligence (e.g. technology-programming/website-development).

parameters.name: skill
parameters.description: A skill page instead of a category (e.g. python, wordpress, logo-design).

parameters.name: experience
parameters.description: Experience levels, comma separated: entry, intermediate, expert.

parameters.name: pricing
parameters.description: Pricing.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Project types, comma separated: urgent, no_proposals, prefunded, featured, opportunity.

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: Remote or on-site projects.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort order.

get.description:
Open freelance projects on PeoplePerHour by category, subcategory or skill, with the site's filters (experience level, fixed or hourly pricing, urgent, no proposals yet, pre-funded, featured, opportunity, remote or on-site) and sort orders. Each project has the title, category, budget with currency and a USD estimate, pricing, proposals count, flags, dates, description and the client's country and member-since date (clients are private people; no names). `facets` gives counts per category, subcategory and filter. 20 per page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/peopleperhour-jobs

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
